scheme_name: Grant of Financial Assistance for Purchase of Textbooks/Notebooks to School-Going Children of Industrial Workers/Employees (GLWB)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a regular industrial worker/employee of the Goa Labour Welfare Board
At least 6 months of continuous service required
Should not be employed in supervisory or managerial roles earning ₹1,600 or above per month
Children must be studying in classes 1st to 4th in recognized/approved schools
Priority given to workers with not more than two children
Selection based on lowest income of the parents and preference for students in higher classes
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹1,800 per child for purchase of textbooks/notebooks for children studying in classes 1st to 4th.
documents_required: Prescribed application form (printed from the official website)
Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested, if required)
